title: Microstructural Characterization of Electrochemically Pulsed Disordered Rocksalt Cathodes
content: The price and scarcity of energy materials threaten the stability of our ever-increasing electric economy. Materials used in commercial batteries, such as LiCoO2 (LCO), LiNi0·80Co0·15Al0·05O2 (NCA), LiNi0·33Mn0·33Co0·33O2 (NMC111) will fall short of the amount required for EV and non-EV uses by 2030 [1]. One element is cobalt, whose supply will fall short of its demand by nearly 50 kilotons in 2030 [1]. Therefore, to meet the demands of battery production, we must investigate battery chemistries that comprise earth abundant elements.
